scope: Selected restored legacy test sources, newly authored Phase 0 fixtures, and the format-only trace sample. Inputs use local allocations, generated byte patterns, constants and test-owned state. Targeted source inspection found no retail input file dependency. Historical authorship of legacy sources was not established. This is not blanket provenance clearance for the repository, implementation sources, or future fixtures.

fixtures.review: Authored synthetic child-process fixtures compile with extracted entry/HLE state alone and with real kernel VEH/syscall code. Actual syscall return, real SysExit in both modes, tracked guest AV classification, and exact process outcomes are observed. Host-stack controls and shared markers distinguish failed recovery from success. No retail input; default syscall-table initialization is not exercised. Repetition observed both AV and BAD_STACK on in-process SysExit; raw outcomes remain diagnostic output while normalized summary records only checked failure to return.

Authored guest HLE exit, AV, CC90 syscall and SysExit snippets plus host-state sentinel wrapper. Direct C++ and host-stack controls constrain wrapper effects. Failure outcomes do not establish host ABI restoration or PS5 accuracy.
Authored state/reset, crash-message and barrier-controlled thread-local host-stack/XMM fixtures using real extracted HLE state. No guest executable, external input or hardware-accuracy claim.

Authored executable byte patterns, owned pages and constructed CONTEXT exercise the real kernel handler, syscall return, classification, crash-state and real exit hooks. Diagnostic histories are deliberately empty; host-stack cases are not switched-stack recovery evidence.

Authored header-matched abort-only link tripwires isolate unused loader, CPU, HLE, graphics and OS-service dependencies. Combined lifecycle build excludes guest-entry/assembly tripwires and links their real implementations. No exercised behavior is replaced.
